dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Individuals without diagnosis datasets feed the training/testing sets; clinical datasets are used in the test set for diagnostic cohorts.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The cohort of individuals without diagnoses was obtained from 132 scanning sites, including various studies such as ABIDE, ADHD200, AOMIC ID1000, Beijing Enhanced, CAMCAN, CoRR, DLBS, DS000119, DS000202, DS000222, Fcon1000, HBN, HCP, MPI Lemon, NKI-Rockland, OASIS-3, PING, SALD, SLIM, and UK Biobank." "As for the clinical datasets, we combined data from ABIDE, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, and TOP (Fig. 1)." "We split our sample of individuals without diagnosis into training and test sets" "However, only the test set consisted of diagnostic groups (for example, AD, ASD, BD) with a minimum of 100 participants." "In this study, we used brain imaging from ABIDE, ADHD200, AOMIC ID1000, Beijing Enhanced, CAMCAN, CoRR, DLBS, DS000119, DS000202, DS000222, Fcon1000, HBN, HCP, MPI Lemon, NKI-Rockland, OASIS-3, PING, SALD, SLIM, and UK Biobank, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, PNC, and TOP."
